# AssemblyAI Documentation

> AssemblyAI provides production-ready Voice AI models for speech-to-text, speaker detection, sentiment analysis, and more. Build with pre-recorded or streaming audio using REST APIs and WebSockets.

This is the structured documentation index for AssemblyAI's public API and product documentation.

## Core machine-readable resources

- [Full documentation content](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/llms-full.txt): Complete generated Markdown content for all local docs pages and configured API specs.
- [Integration prompt](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/agent-instructions.md): Rules of the road for AI coding agents building AssemblyAI integrations.
- [Documentation index](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/llms.txt): This file.

## Overview

- [AssemblyAI Documentation](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs) (Getting started): Build with our Voice AI Infrastructure
- [Build with AI coding agents](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/coding-agent-prompts) (Getting started): Build with AssemblyAI using Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, Devin, and other AI coding assistants. Copy the integration prompt, pin the URL in your agent's project instructions, connect the docs MCP server, or install the Claude Code skill.
- [Models](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/getting-started/models) (Getting started): AssemblyAI's speech-to-text models and their capabilities
- [Evaluations](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/evaluations) (Getting started): Figure out which STT models are best for your product with an evaluation.
- [Account Management](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/account-management) (Getting started): Account Management documentation.
- [Billing and Pricing](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/billing-and-pricing) (Getting started): Billing and Pricing documentation.
- [Introducing Universal-3 Pro](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/getting-started/universal-3-pro) (Getting started): Learn how to transcribe audio using Universal-3 Pro.
- [End-to-end examples](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/getting-started/end-to-end-examples) (Getting started > End-to-end examples): Copy-paste pipelines that combine multiple AssemblyAI products in a single script.
- [Meeting notetaker](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/getting-started/end-to-end-examples/meeting-notetaker) (Getting started > End-to-end examples): Transcribe a team meeting with speaker labels, identify speakers by name, then generate structured meeting notes with LLM Gateway.
- [Sales call intelligence](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/getting-started/end-to-end-examples/sales-call-intelligence) (Getting started > End-to-end examples): Transcribe a sales call with speaker labels and sentiment analysis, identify speakers by role, then generate a coaching scorecard with LLM Gateway.
- [Medical scribe](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/getting-started/end-to-end-examples/medical-scribe) (Getting started > End-to-end examples): Transcribe a clinical encounter using Medical Mode with speaker labels and entity detection, then generate a structured SOAP note with LLM Gateway.
- [Content repurposing](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/getting-started/end-to-end-examples/content-repurposing) (Getting started > End-to-end examples): Transcribe a podcast or webinar, extract key phrases, then generate a blog post draft with LLM Gateway.
- [Real-time meeting assistant](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/getting-started/end-to-end-examples/real-time-meeting-assistant) (Getting started > End-to-end examples): Stream audio from your microphone with speaker diarization and LLM Gateway for live transcription and automatic summaries.
- [Real-time live captioner](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/getting-started/end-to-end-examples/real-time-live-captioner) (Getting started > End-to-end examples): Stream audio from your microphone with keyterms prompting for domain-specific accuracy, ideal for live events and accessibility.
- [Best Practices for building Meeting Notetakers](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/meeting-notetaker-best-practices) (Use cases & integrations > Use case guides): Complete guide for building meeting notetakers with AssemblyAI
- [Build a medical scribe](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/medical-scribe-best-practices) (Use cases & integrations > Use case guides > Build a medical scribe): Build AI-powered medical scribes that transcribe patient encounters and generate clinical documentation.
- [Build a Post-Visit Medical Scribe](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/medical-scribe-best-practices/medical-scribe-post-visit) (Use cases & integrations > Use case guides > Build a medical scribe): Complete example implementing pre-recorded transcription with Universal-3 Pro for post-visit clinical documentation.
- [Build a Real-Time Medical Scribe](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/medical-scribe-best-practices/medical-scribe-real-time) (Use cases & integrations > Use case guides > Build a medical scribe): Complete example for real-time streaming medical transcription with LLM Gateway post-processing and SOAP note generation.
- [Best Practices for Building Voice Agents](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/voice-agents/best-practices) (Use cases & integrations > Use case guides): Complete guide for building voice agents with AssemblyAI's Universal-3 Pro Streaming
- [Best Practices for building Contact Center Applications](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/contact-center-best-practices) (Use cases & integrations > Use case guides): Complete guide for building contact center applications with AssemblyAI

## API Reference

- [Overview](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/overview) (Overview): AssemblyAI API reference overview.
- [Upload a media file](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/files/upload) (Files): Upload a media file to AssemblyAI.
- [Submit a transcript](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/transcripts/submit) (Transcripts): Create a transcription request.
- [Get a transcript](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/transcripts/get) (Transcripts): Retrieve a transcript by ID.
- [Get transcript sentences](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/transcripts/get-sentences) (Transcripts): Retrieve transcript sentences.
- [Get transcript paragraphs](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/transcripts/get-paragraphs) (Transcripts): Retrieve transcript paragraphs.
- [Get subtitles](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/transcripts/get-subtitles) (Transcripts): Export subtitles for a transcript.
- [Get redacted audio](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/transcripts/get-redacted-audio) (Transcripts): Retrieve redacted audio for a transcript.
- [Word search](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/transcripts/word-search) (Transcripts): Search a transcript for words or phrases.
- [List transcripts](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/transcripts/list) (Transcripts): List transcripts.
- [Delete a transcript](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/transcripts/delete) (Transcripts): Delete a transcript.
- [Create a chat completion](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/llm-gateway/create-chat-completion) (LLM Gateway): Create a chat completion with LLM Gateway.
- [Create speech understanding](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/llm-gateway/create-speech-understanding) (LLM Gateway): Apply LLM Gateway to audio transcripts.
- [Generate streaming token](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/streaming-api/generate-streaming-token) (Streaming API): Generate a temporary token for Real-time STT.
- [Universal Streaming](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/streaming-api/universal-streaming) (Streaming API): AsyncAPI reference for Universal Streaming.
- [Universal-3.5 Pro Streaming](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/streaming-api/universal-3-pro-streaming) (Streaming API): AsyncAPI reference for Universal-3.5 Pro Streaming.
- [Generate voice agent token](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/voice-agent-api/generate-voice-agent-token) (Voice Agent API): Generate a temporary token for the Voice Agent API.
- [Voice Agent WebSocket](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/voice-agent-api/voice-agent-web-socket) (Voice Agent API): AsyncAPI reference for the Voice Agent WebSocket.
- [Create an agent](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/voice-agent-api/create-agent) (Voice Agent API > Agents): Create a reusable voice agent.
- [List agents](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/voice-agent-api/list-agents) (Voice Agent API > Agents): List the voice agents for your account.
- [Retrieve an agent](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/voice-agent-api/get-agent) (Voice Agent API > Agents): Retrieve a voice agent by ID.
- [Update an agent](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/voice-agent-api/update-agent) (Voice Agent API > Agents): Update a voice agent.
- [Delete an agent](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/voice-agent-api/delete-agent) (Voice Agent API > Agents): Delete a voice agent.
- [Create a webhook subscription](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/voice-agent-api/create-webhook-subscription) (Voice Agent API > Webhooks): Create a webhook subscription documentation.
- [List webhook subscriptions](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/voice-agent-api/list-webhook-subscriptions) (Voice Agent API > Webhooks): List webhook subscriptions documentation.
- [Retrieve a webhook subscription](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/voice-agent-api/get-webhook-subscription) (Voice Agent API > Webhooks): Retrieve a webhook subscription documentation.
- [Update a webhook subscription](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/voice-agent-api/update-webhook-subscription) (Voice Agent API > Webhooks): Update a webhook subscription documentation.
- [Delete a webhook subscription](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/api-reference/voice-agent-api/delete-webhook-subscription) (Voice Agent API > Webhooks): Delete a webhook subscription documentation.

## Real-time STT

## Voice Agent API

- [Voice Agent API](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/voice-agents/voice-agent-api) (Getting started): Real-time voice agents that talk and listen. Configure an agent once, then deploy it to a browser, your own app, or the phone.
- [Build with AI coding tools](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/voice-agents/voice-agent-api/build-with-ai-tools) (Getting started): Point your AI coding assistant at AssemblyAI's live docs so it writes correct, current Voice Agent code instead of guessing from stale training data.
- [Supported languages](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/voice-agents/voice-agent-api/supported-languages) (Getting started): Input and output languages supported by the Voice Agent API.
- [Create an agent](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/voice-agents/voice-agent-api/create-agent) (Create & manage agents): Create a reusable voice agent with a single REST call.
- [Manage agents](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/voice-agents/voice-agent-api/manage-agents) (Create & manage agents): REST reference for creating and managing reusable voice agents. Endpoints, request and response schemas, the HTTP tool schema, and validation rules.
- [Prompting guide](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/voice-agents/voice-agent-api/prompting-guide) (Configure): Patterns for writing system prompts that improve instruction following, conversationality, and voice output quality.
- [Greeting](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/voice-agents/voice-agent-api/greeting) (Configure): Set the exact words a voice agent speaks when a conversation starts, or omit it to listen first.
- [Voices](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/voice-agents/voice-agent-api/voices) (Configure): Pick a voice that matches your agent's personality and language.
- [Audio & volume](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/voice-agents/voice-agent-api/audio) (Configure): Configure a voice agent's input and output audio encoding and playback volume.
- [Turn detection and interruptions](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/voice-agents/voice-agent-api/turn-detection-and-interruptions) (Configure): How the Voice Agent API decides when the user has finished speaking and when they're interrupting. On by default, no tuning required.
- [Key terms](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/voice-agents/voice-agent-api/keyterms) (Configure): Boost transcription accuracy for rare or domain-specific words by adding them to a voice agent's key terms.
- [Tools](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/voice-agents/voice-agent-api/tools/overview) (Configure > Tools): Give your agent tools to fetch data and take actions, plus the parameter hints, execution modes, and patterns that make tool calls and turn-taking reliable.
- [HTTP tools](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/voice-agents/voice-agent-api/tools/http-tools) (Configure > Tools): Server-side tools. Give your agent a URL and a parameter list, and AssemblyAI makes the request for you when the model calls the tool.
- [Client-side tools](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/voice-agents/voice-agent-api/tools/client-side-tools) (Configure > Tools): Function tools your own code runs. Declare them inline, handle the tool.call, and return a tool.result without breaking turn-taking.
- [Connect your own LLM](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/voice-agents/voice-agent-api/connect-your-own-llm) (Configure): Point a voice agent at your own OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint instead of AssemblyAI's managed model.
- [Deploy your agent](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/voice-agents/voice-agent-api/deploy) (Deploy): Connect to your voice agent over the realtime WebSocket from a server, a browser, or the phone — all by referencing the same agent_id.
- [Browser integration](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/voice-agents/voice-agent-api/browser-integration) (Deploy): Connect browser-based apps to the Voice Agent API using a temporary token.
- [Connect to Twilio](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/voice-agents/voice-agent-api/connect-to-twilio) (Deploy): Bridge Twilio phone calls to the Voice Agent API with zero transcoding.
- [Audio format](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/voice-agents/voice-agent-api/audio-format) (Deploy): Supported encodings, sample rates, and how to stream and play Voice Agent API audio.
- [Inline session configuration](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/voice-agents/voice-agent-api/session-configuration) (Reference): Configure a voice agent at connect-time over the WebSocket with session.update, without storing an agent.
- [Webhooks](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/voice-agents/voice-agent-api/webhooks) (Reference): Subscribe to session and call lifecycle events for your agents. AssemblyAI POSTs a signed JSON payload to your URL when each event fires.
- [Events reference](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/voice-agents/voice-agent-api/events-reference) (Reference): Every client-to-server and server-to-client event for the Voice Agent API.
- [Troubleshooting](https://www.assemblyai.com/docs/voice-agents/voice-agent-api/troubleshooting) (Reference): Common issues and fixes when building with the Voice Agent API.
